texts:
Wednesday's practice reports are in. Here is what moved for Week 6, team by team.

Lamar Jackson still has not practiced.

Caleb Williams was full.

CeeDee Lamb practiced in full.

Let's get to it.
#RavensFlock #DaBears #DallasCowboys

Lamar Jackson has not practiced since the Oct. 4 ankle injury, Wednesday included, and Tyler Huntley starts @CLE if he sits.

Jackson is QB16 for me this week, a streamer. Monitor; Friday's injury report.
#RavensFlock #DawgPound

Ja'Kobi Lane is back at practice off IR after wrist surgery and starts out as Baltimore's No. 3 receiver.

Lane is WR75 rest of season for me. Monitor; his route share @CLE Sunday.
#RavensFlock

Caleb Williams was a full participant Wednesday off the hamstring that kept him out of Week 5.

Williams is QB8 for me @ATL.

Colston Loveland gets his quarterback back. TE15 for me this week, a streamer, and TE4 rest of season. Hold him.
#DaBears #DirtyBirds

Michael Penix Jr. practiced Wednesday with the ribs, and Kevin Stefanski says he starts vs CHI if all goes to plan.

Penix is QB22 for me, outside my top 12. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Drake London is WR5 for me.
#DirtyBirds #DaBears

Quinshon Judkins is out of the walking boot but did not practice Wednesday with the right ankle. RB33 for me vs BAL, a low-end RB3. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Dylan Sampson practiced off IR. Stash him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.
#DawgPound #RavensFlock

Cleveland put Raheim Sanders on IR with the hip and signed Audric Estime. Sanders is RB79 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add on the list.

Denzel Boston ran a route on 91 percent of the dropbacks @PIT. WR19 for me vs BAL, a WR2.
#DawgPound

Baker Mayfield was not at Wednesday's practice with the dislocated right thumb, and Mike Garafolo reports he is unlikely to play vs PIT.

Mayfield is QB24 rest of season for me. Monitor; Friday's injury report.
#GoBucs #HereWeGo

Mike McCarthy calls Jaylen Warren the featured back with Rico Dowdle getting healthy. Warren is RB6 for me @TB.

Germie Bernard led Pittsburgh with 9 targets in Week 5 with three receivers out. WR34 for me, a low-end WR3.
#HereWeGo #GoBucs

Rashee Rice did not practice Wednesday with the hamstring.

Rice is WR27 for me vs LAC, a high-end WR3, and a sit without a full practice by Friday. Monitor; Friday's injury report.
#ChiefsKingdom #BoltUp

Jim Harbaugh said Ladd McConkey may work back in from the foot. Outside my top 50 receivers @KC until he plays. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Quentin Johnston (chest) should be limited. WR44 rest of season for me. Monitor; Friday's designation.
#BoltUp #ChiefsKingdom

Tre' Harris is week to week with the hamstring, and the bye follows Week 6. WR63 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add on the list.

Kimani Vidal's snap share has climbed five straight weeks, to 42 percent. Add him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.
#BoltUp

CeeDee Lamb practiced in full Wednesday, three days after the quad bruise vs TB.

Lamb is WR3 for me @GB Sunday night.
#DallasCowboys #GoPackGo

Chris Olave did not practice Wednesday with an illness. WR6 for me @NYG for now. Monitor; Thursday's practice report.

Tyler Shough practiced in full through the left hand. QB13 for me, a borderline start this week.
#Saints #NYGiants

Alvin Kamara was limited Wednesday with the back. RB26 for me @NYG, a high-end RB3. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Kendre Miller took 10 carries and a TD vs MIN while Kamara played 12 snaps. RB32 for me, a low-end RB3.
#Saints #NYGiants

Breece Hall is still week to week with the quad and likely out @NE.

Braelon Allen played all but two snaps without Hall in Week 4. RB19 for me this week, an RB2.

Rhamondre Stevenson is RB12 for me vs NYJ, borderline RB1/RB2.
#JetUp #NEPats

A.J. Brown practiced Wednesday, opening his 21-day IR window, and Mack Hollins is on IR through at least Week 8.

Brown is WR24 rest of season for me. Monitor; his activation before NYJ.
#NEPats #JetUp

Klint Kubiak says Ashton Jeanty plays vs BUF through the foot. His touches have fallen four straight weeks, from 29 to 13.

Jeanty is RB13 for me, borderline RB1/RB2 this week.
#RaiderNation #BillsMafia

Jeremiyah Love sat out Wednesday's practice to rest the ankle. RB18 for me @LAR, an RB2. Monitor; Thursday's practice report.

Tyler Allgeier is RB36 for me, a low-end RB3, and the pivot if Love sits.
#BirdGang #RamsHouse

Jordan Mason is expected back from IR after Minnesota's bye. Stash him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.

Chase Brown out-snapped Samaje Perine 38 to 33 @MIA. RB6 rest of season for me. Trade for Brown; offer an RB2 and a WR3.
#Skol #WhoDey

DeMeco Ryans says Marvin Harrison Jr. makes his Houston debut @JAX in London. Hold him; his route share Sunday is the test.

Woody Marks played 56 of 65 snaps once David Montgomery left. RB20 for me, an RB2.
#HTownMade #DUUUVAL

Sean Payton is calling Denver's plays again. J.K. Dobbins ran 18 times for 68 and a TD in Payton's first game calling them. RB27 for me vs SEA Thursday, a high-end RB3.

Jaxon Smith-Njigba was limited Tuesday with the ankle. WR2 for me @DEN.
#BroncosCountry #Seahawks

Every note from today is on the Pass, with Thursday's practice reports next.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for Thursday's lineup calls, and like this if it helped your week.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/pass.html
